title: Helicopter crashes outside Montreal killing all four occupants
summary: Police are investigating after a helicopter crashed in a field near the Rang des Écossais in the municipality of Sainte-Brigide-d’Iberville on Saturday afternoon.

image.caption: The helicopter was on fire when first responders arrived at the scene, police said. (Emily Blais/Radio-Canada)

blocks.text: Police are investigating after a helicopter crashed in a field near the Rang des Écossais in the municipality of Sainte-Brigide-d’Iberville on Saturday afternoon.
Police are investigating after a helicopter crashed in a field near the Rang des Écossais off Highway 10 in the municipality of Sainte-Brigide-d’Iberville on Saturday afternoon.
Sûreté du Québec spokesperson Brigitte Dorsainville said it happened at around 2:30 p.m. ET and the helicopter was on fire when first responders arrived.
Dorsainville said all four occupants on board were declared dead at the scene.
Police, however, were unable to provide details on the ownership of the helicopter, where it took off or the identities of the victims, citing early stages of the investigation.
The fire has since been brought under control and the SQ's major crimes unit has taken over the file.
The Transportation Safety Board of Canada is also sending a team of investigators to the site, police said.
Sainte-Brigide-d’Iberville is located roughly 55 kilometres southeast of Montreal.
